name: @rizzy-vault/extension
description: The browser extension (ADR 0036; ROADMAP §4.4): Chromium (MV3) and Firefox, React over packages/core in one long-lived context (offscreen document / background page), a framework-free content script, and an IndexedDB cache in ADR 0026 §3's form.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm run build:chromium && pnpm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chromium: vite build --mode chromium && RIZZY_CONTENT_ENTRY=content-script vite build --mode chromium --config vite.content.config.ts && RIZZY_CONTENT_ENTRY=passkey-relay vite build --mode chromium --config vite.content.config.ts && RIZZY_CONTENT_ENTRY=passkey-page-shim vite build --mode chromium --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.build:firefox: vite build --mode firefox && RIZZY_CONTENT_ENTRY=content-script vite build --mode firefox --config vite.content.config.ts && RIZZY_CONTENT_ENTRY=passkey-relay vite build --mode firefox --config vite.content.config.ts && RIZZY_CONTENT_ENTRY=passkey-page-shim vite build --mode firefox --config vite.content.config.ts
